what: Hovering a photo card (or focus inside it) makes a ”See more” button rise in .3s from its own height below (translateY 100%) inside a hidden window at the card’s bottom edge, and on leave it goes back down the same path and hides. Attaching the window with sticky bottom makes it rise from the screen bottom edge even on long cards. On devices without hover, the whole window is hidden

options.--fx-ease: Curve (via style), default cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) — Tailwind transition default
options.[data-fx-part=window]: Clipping window (overflow hidden) — empty panel placed at the bottom of the card
options.[data-fx-part=peek]: What rises from inside the window (button · one line of text)
